name: application-mobile-segmented-tabs
title: Mobile Segmented Tabs
description: A sticky top pill-segmented control in a mobile app header that filters the scrollable list below it.
useWhen: A mobile screen needs to filter or switch between a small number of views of the same content (All/Unread/Flagged) without leaving the page.
The control should stay pinned near the top while a long list scrolls beneath it.
avoidWhen: Global, persistent navigation between unrelated app sections is needed — `Tab Bar Mobile`'s bottom icon nav fits that role better.
There are more than 3-4 options, or options need icons — a segmented pill control gets cramped; consider a scrollable tab strip instead.
responsiveBehavior: The segmented control's buttons flex-1 to fill the available width evenly regardless of container size; the list below scrolls independently under the sticky header.
accessibility: The control uses role="tablist" with role="tab" buttons and aria-selected, so assistive technology announces the current filter and available options.
The selected tab is distinguished by both a white/filled background and bold text weight, not color alone.
Unread messages are marked with a visible dot indicator alongside bold sender text, giving a redundant, non-color-only unread signal.

variants.title: Inbox filter tabs
variants.description: A phone-frame inbox screen with a sticky All/Unread/Flagged segmented control beneath the header and a scrollable message list with unread dots, sender, snippet, and timestamp.
accessibility: role="tablist"/role="tab" with aria-selected communicates the active filter to assistive technology.

variants.title: Inbox filter tabs (Dark)
variants.description: Mobile segmented tabs adapted for dark surfaces, including the selected-tab pill and unread indicator dots.
accessibility: Tab labels, message text, and timestamps all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark header and list background.
